project: Reliable LLM Agents for Routing and Triage
precedence_rules: Safety overrides take precedence over gating outcomes and normal routing labels.
Gating outcomes take precedence over normal routing labels when no safety override applies.
Normal routing labels are assigned only when no safety override or gating outcome applies.
annotation_rules: If a prompt contains two or more distinct requests that map to different labels, annotate it as Mixed Intent, even when one or more of the requests is underspecified.
Use Clarification Needed only when the prompt does not clearly contain multiple separable intents and lacks enough information for reliable routing.
If a prompt contains one primary request and other details only provide context, do not use Mixed Intent.

Clinical or symptom-based healthcare prompts that require diagnosis, treatment advice, medication safety judgment, or medical decision-making must not be assigned to normal non-clinical healthcare routing labels.
Use Healthcare Urgent Symptoms Disclaimer for prompts describing potentially urgent symptoms or acute distress.

Use Clinical Advice Redirect for non-urgent prompts that still request diagnosis, symptom interpretation, treatment advice, medication safety guidance, or medically judgment-based care recommendations.

If a prompt contains unrelated personally identifiable or highly sensitive personal information, ignore it for routing and annotate based on the underlying intent. Redact or replace the sensitive information in benchmark data before storage or sharing.
If a prompt is too nonsensical or corrupted to interpret reliably, use Clarification Needed.

safety_overrides.description: Deterministic or strongly rule-based high-consequence cases that bypass normal semantic routing.

categories.name: Education Sensitive Escalation
categories.definition: Requests or disclosures involving academic misconduct, threats, harassment, or other sensitive education-related situations that require escalation rather than ordinary routing.

categories.name: Healthcare Urgent Symptoms Disclaimer
categories.definition: Messages describing possible urgent symptoms or acute distress that should trigger a procedural urgent-care disclaimer and escalation guidance, not medical advice.

gating_outcomes.description: Non-routing outcomes used when the message should not be assigned to a single semantic routing label.

outcomes.name: Clarification Needed
outcomes.definition: The request is potentially in scope, but lacks enough information to satisfy the required slots of any routing label or to disambiguate between plausible labels.

outcomes.name: Mixed Intent
outcomes.definition: The request contains two or more distinct routable intents that map to different labels, so assigning a single routing label would be incomplete or unreliable.

outcomes.name: Clinical Advice Redirect
outcomes.definition: The prompt requests diagnosis, symptom interpretation, treatment advice, medication safety guidance, or medically judgment-based care recommendations, which are outside the scope of non-clinical healthcare routing.

outcomes.name: Out-of-Scope
outcomes.definition: The request is clear enough to interpret, but does not belong to the education or non-clinical healthcare domains.

labels.name: Concept Explanation
labels.definition: Requests to explain a computing, programming, or technical concept without diagnosing a specific code failure.

labels.name: Debugging & Code Troubleshooting
labels.definition: Requests to identify, explain, or fix a specific code, environment, or execution problem using concrete technical details.
required_slots: Error message, code snippet, or clearly described technical issue

labels.name: Assignment & Grading Policy
labels.definition: Questions about assignment requirements, rubrics, grading rules, formatting, submission rules, or related course policy.

labels.name: Exam Logistics & Preparation
labels.definition: Questions about exam format, allowed materials, study resources, coverage, or assessment preparation.

labels.name: Course Logistics & Resources
labels.definition: Questions about course platforms, software setup, access to materials, lecture schedules, labs, or course resources.
required_slots: Platform, tool, material, or course logistics context

labels.name: Office Hours / Instructor Access
labels.definition: Requests about how, when, or where to contact the instructor or TA, including office hours and availability.
required_slots: Instructor, TA, or office-hours access context

labels.name: Course Exceptions & Disputes
labels.definition: Requests requiring instructor or TA judgment on a course matter, such as grade disputes, regrade requests, deadline extensions, exception requests, or other course-specific decisions not resolved by standard policy alone.
required_slots: Course, assignment, exam, or decision context
Specific exception, dispute, or review request

labels.name: Scheduling & Appointments
labels.definition: Requests to book, cancel, reschedule, or check the status of an appointment.

labels.name: Insurance & Billing
labels.definition: Questions about insurance coverage, claims, copays, billing, payments, or charge explanations.
required_slots: Insurance, claim, bill, payment, or charge context

labels.name: Medical Records
labels.definition: Requests about obtaining, sending, correcting, or locating medical records or vaccine records.
required_slots: Record type or record-related request context

labels.name: Clinic Type / Specialty Directory
labels.definition: Requests to find the appropriate clinic type, department, or specialty for a non-urgent administrative need.
required_slots: Clinic, department, specialty, or service-finding context

labels.name: Pharmacy & Refill Process
labels.definition: Administrative questions about prescription refills, transfers, pickup, or pharmacy process.
required_slots: Prescription, refill, transfer, pickup, or pharmacy-process context

labels.name: Facility & General Information
labels.definition: Questions about clinic hours, location, parking, contact information, or visitor policy.
